_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "confirmed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_path" TEXT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at" INTEGER NULL, "source_label" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "device_id" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "persons" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "related_task_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_persons" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id), "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES persons (id), PRIMARY KEY ("event_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "todo_status" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_done" IN (0, 1)), "priority" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_markdown" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "device_id" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "campus_places" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_dx" REAL NOT NULL, "normalized_dy" REAL NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone_id" INTEGER NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "is_mine" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_mine" IN (0, 1)), "last_visited_at" INTEGER NULL, "log_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "heat_score" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pdf_library_documents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '未分类', "last_page" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "page_count" INTEGER NULL, "last_opened_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "device_id" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "storage_key" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pdf_library_annotations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "document_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pdf_library_documents (id), "page_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opacity" REAL NOT NULL, "selected_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "rects_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" INTEGER NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "device_id" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_value" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scope"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_chat_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_chat_messages" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_chat_sessions (id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "reasoning_content" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
